findings.summary: _restoreAudioSession uses iosCategory 'soloAmbient' instead of 'ambient'. After hang-up, soloAmbient keeps other audio silenced for the session; ambient allows it to mix back in. Change to 'ambient'.

_restoreAudioSession uses interruptionModeIOS: 2 (DuckOthers) instead of 0 (MixWithOthers). Background audio that was playing before the call will not return to full volume. Change the literal to 0 (InterruptionModeIOS.MixWithOthers).

_finalCleanup does not call NativeCallKit.endCall(callId) directly. All current caller paths (endCall, rejectCall, cancelCall) do call it before reaching _finalCleanup, so there is no active bug today, but the design is brittle — any future direct caller of _finalCleanup will silently skip CallKit teardown. Move the NativeCallKit.endCall call into _finalCleanup guarded by session?.callId.
